leadText:
Mirror Team Rocket (Japanese: 鏡の国ロケット団 Mirror World Rocket-dan) are characters of the day who appeared in The Cave of Mirrors!. They are the Mirror World counterparts of . Their personalities are opposite to that of the regular Jessie, James, and , as they are heroes who fight criminals and evildoers. They also have distinctly deeper voices than their normal selves, and the "R" on their uniforms is horizontally mirrored.

Mirror Team Rocket was first mentioned when the of the regular world and the Mirror World counterparts of himself and encountered the Team Rocket of the regular world. The regular Ash mentioned how they were thieves, and Mirror Serena expressed her confusion, since the Team Rocket she and her friends knew were heroes of justice who always fought the villains. 

Later, when the regular Team Rocket was blasted off and still trapped in the Mirror World, they encountered Mirror Team Rocket. The regular Team Rocket watched in agony as Mirror Team Rocket cited their and introduced themselves as "the Heroes of Justice".
